Definition: from G4012 and G5143 (including its alternate); to run around, i.e. traverse:--run through.
BiblicalUsage: Peritrecho means to run around, to traverse a whole district. When Jesus landed at Gennesaret, the people ran through that whole region, carrying the sick on beds to wherever they heard He was.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that their running shows me what real need looks like: when people know where healing is, they do not walk, they run, and they carry others with them.
